text:
Theo Park: Hey everyone, Theo starting Monday on Platform. I can open most onboarding pages in Notion but only have view access. My manager asked me to prepare a "sandbox" copy of the First-Week checklist that the buddy and I can iterate on before we hand it back to the team. Quick q: what's the cleanest way to get temporary edit rights for a page or to create a sandbox that doesn't trigger automations?

Anya Li: Welcome Theo! Two safe options depending on your preference: (A) Page-level Editor on the canonical page so you edit in-place under a clearly marked Draft section, or (B) duplicate the page into Team > Platform > Sandboxes and mark it as a staging copy. For (B) set a property `AutomationScope=staging` so scripts ignore the copy.

devex: If you want us to add page-level editors, DM @devex with the page URL + SSO email + duration. Fast template to use in the DM: 
```
@devex please add Editor on <NOTION_URL> for:
- Theo Park (theo@redwood.com)
Duration: 14 days
Reason: sandbox copy for first-week checklist edits and buddy review
```
We default to page-level editors and avoid workspace-level rights.

infra-bot: Heads up: our CI->Notion hooks watch canonical page IDs only. Duplicates will not inherit webhooks or automated Jira creation. If you plan to promote a sandbox to canonical, ping infra to reattach hooks after promotion.

Sam Rogers: A few practical tips from doing this last quarter: (1) prefix your sandbox page title with `SANDBOX -` so it's obvious. (2) Add a `Source` property with the canonical URL. (3) Add a `PublishChecklist` at the top (3 bullets) so reviewers know what to verify before promote.

Theo Park: Nice, that helps. If I duplicate the checklist, will database columns like Owner/Status/Due copy over? I want to keep the same schema so managers can assign owners during review.

Anya Li: Yes the DB schema and properties copy. Caveats: saved views and filters copy too — double-check the default view so nothing important is hidden. Also comments on the original do NOT copy to the duplicate.

Priya (People Ops): If the checklist contains any HR forms/links, replace them with placeholders in the sandbox (e.g., `[HR-form-placeholder]`) or tag People Ops for a quick review before sharing with hires. We occasionally run a short review for new-hire facing docs.

Theo Park: Great. Another ask: what's our canonical naming convention for ramp/onboard pages so the indexing script picks them up later?

Sam Rogers: We use `Onboard - <FirstLast> - <Team> - <MonYYYY>` for individual pages and `Template - <Team> - <ShortTitle>` for canonical templates. The promote-to-canonical step should update `Status=Canonical` and set the Owner property to the person's Notion account (not a text field).

devex: Small checklist for promoting a sandbox to canonical so ops can reattach automations without surprises: 
1) Set `Status=Canonical` and `Source` to blank or the final canonical URL.
2) Update `Owner` property to the new canonical owner.
3) Remove `SANDBOX -` prefix from title.
4) DM @devex with the promote request block including target folder. Example: 
```
@devex please promote https://redwood.notion.so/sandbox-page-abc to canonical
Target folder: Redwood > Eng > Platform > Templates
Promoted by: Sam Rogers (sam@redwood.com)
Reason: finished review and sanitized links
```
We run a quick automation check before flipping any hooks.

Theo Park: Awesome, will duplicate and follow the SANDBOX pattern, add `AutomationScope=staging`, and DM @devex for temporary Editor rights for 14 days. One last thing: who should I tag if I find outdated steps in the canonical template?

Anya Li: Check the right-hand page properties for `Owner`. If that's blank, tag `docs-triage` or ping me and I'll route it. We also have a Docs Backlog board — if it's a bigger change, file it there with links and desired edits.

Theo Park: Thanks team 44b Super helpful. I'll proceed and ping when ready for promotion.

infra-bot: Reminder: automation sweep ignores pages where `AutomationScope=staging` or `Status=Draft`. Ensure those are set to avoid accidental trigger.

Sam Rogers: small PS: if you want reviewers to complete a checklist before promote, add a boolean property `ReadyForPublish` and ask reviewers to set it to `Yes`. Docs triage watches for that flag.

Theo Park: Got it. Appreciate the quick answers! :raised_hands:
